applicationInfo.name: Threat Model Export
applicationInfo.description: Bedrock Budget Guard (BBG) is an AWS-native, multi-account cost-control system that meters Amazon Bedrock spend per IAM principal and automatically attaches a scoped IAM Deny policy when a principal exceeds its USD budget or request/token rate limit. It ingests Bedrock invocation logs + CloudTrail data events (home account directly, member accounts via CloudWatch Logs subscription -> cross-account EventBridge), joins usage to the calling IAM principal, accumulates spend in DynamoDB, and a DynamoDB-stream-driven enforcement Lambda builds and attaches a bbg-deny-* customer-managed policy. Enforcement reaches member accounts by assuming a bbg-enforcement role provisioned via CloudFormation StackSets. An admin SPA (CloudFront+S3, WAFv2, Cognito passkey auth, API Gateway HTTP API with a Cognito JWT authorizer) lets scoped admins manage budgets, defaults, enrollment, users, and pricing overrides. BBG stores spend metadata + budgets, NOT customer prompt/response content. This threat model is published alongside the sample so adopters can see the analysis.

assumptions.content: BBG's home account and each enrolled member account are within the same AWS Organization and under common trust; the home account is a trusted security/governance account. Member accounts deploy the bbg-enforcement role via StackSets.

The worst realistic impact of a BBG compromise is availability/cost (denying legitimate Bedrock access, or failing to deny an over-budget principal so spend continues) rather than a confidentiality breach — BBG stores spend metadata + budgets, not customer content or Bedrock prompt/response bodies.

Residual-risk calibration (A002): with no customer content stored, residual severities are graded against cost/availability. The 5 originally code-mitigated threats (ENF-3, POL-2, AUZ-3, API-2, EDGE-1) were resolved by existing code; the other 7 (ENF-1, ENF-2, POL-1, AUZ-1, AUZ-2, API-1, MET-1) were remediated before the initial public release and independently re-verified against the fixed code — all 12 threats are now Resolved. None is Critical because worst-case is bounded to cost overrun or bounded Bedrock denial, not a confidentiality breach.

mitigations.content: ENF-1 (remediated pre-release): Member bbg-enforcement role permissions are tightly scoped to bbg-deny-* only; the AssumeRolePolicyDocument now also carries an aws:PrincipalOrgID StringEquals condition (Org ID auto-detected at synth; allowlist-only fallback with a synth warning when unavailable) — member-stackset-stack.ts:154-171,240-245.

ENF-2 (remediated pre-release): Operator kill-switch bbg:pauseEnforcement -> ENFORCEMENT_PAUSED env makes the enforcement Lambda skip new deny attaches (emits EnforcementPaused, no-ops) — enforcement/index.ts:366-375; enforcement-stack.ts:43-44,69. EnforcementAppliedRate alarm (5-min Sum > 25, SNS-wired) pages on mass-enforcement — observability-stack.ts:92-98,166-175,261-263.
ENF-3: Detach failures at rollover are retried, alarmed, and the stuck-attach path emits a dedicated metric with a runbook.

POL-1 (remediated pre-release): Deny policy covers FM invoke/converse/stream, inference-profile, KB retrieve, agent invoke, and standalone guardrails; FM_ACTIONS now also denies bedrock:StartAsyncInvoke, CreateModelInvocationJob (batch), and InvokeModelWithBidirectionalStream — policies.ts:37-39.
POL-2: Deny policy documents are small in practice; monitor for the IAM 6KB managed-policy limit on large multi-profile targets.

AUZ-1 (remediated pre-release): Every admin write derives caller scope server-side and gates cross-account writes with scopeAllows; global routes are wildcard-only. The fail-open is fixed: API Lambdas set AWS_ACCOUNT_ID (api-stack.ts:73) and scopeGuardResult() rejects (403) a non-wildcard caller when the target account is empty/unparseable, applied at all 5 write sites — api/budgets/index.ts:183-197,366-369,450-453,502-505,524-527,558-561.

AUZ-2 (remediated pre-release): Legacy Admins->wildcard fallback removed from deriveScope (pre-token-gen/index.ts:26-35) and the callerScope compat fallback (shared/api.ts:80-87); an Admins-only user now derives empty scope. Confirmed the BBG-Admin-Wildcard group membership in both live pools before removal.
AUZ-3: bbg:scope is server-derived by the Cognito pre-token-gen trigger and delivered in a Cognito-signed JWT the client cannot forge; API GW validates issuer+audience.

API-1 (remediated pre-release): isValidTarget() rejects (400) any budget target not matching model#<id>/model#*/profile#<arn>/profile#* on both POST and PUT before persisting, so resourcesFor() never falls back to Resource:'*' — api/budgets/index.ts:125-130,356-360,443-447.
API-2: Every admin write emits a structured kind:audit log line + CrossAccountWriteAudit metric.

MET-1 (remediated pre-release): Metering is idempotent, joins late-arriving identities via a pending queue, forwards cross-region, and is cross-checked by the CUR reconciler. MeterUnjoinedAlarm and ReconciliationDeltaAlarm both exist and are SNS-wired with MET-1 runbook descriptions — observability-stack.ts:101-116,132-149,261-263.
EDGE-1: Public config.json contains only non-secret client config; CloudFront is fronted by WAFv2 managed rules + per-IP rate limit.

threats.threatSource: An actor able to assume the member bbg-enforcement role (e.g. via a compromised home enforcement Lambda role, or a mis-scoped trust)
threats.prerequisites: Ability to call sts:AssumeRole on arn:...:role/bbg-enforcement in a member account
threats.threatAction: Attach a bbg-deny-* Bedrock Deny to any principal in the member account, or abuse the role's IAM policy-management perms
threats.threatImpact: Denial of Bedrock for arbitrary member principals (availability). Cannot exfiltrate data or touch non-bbg-deny-* policies.

Cannot exfiltrate data or touch non-bbg-deny-* policies.

threats.threatSource: Compromised or buggy home-account enforcement Lambda (supply chain, bad deploy)
threats.prerequisites: Control of / a defect in the enforcement Lambda; RUNNING_SPEND stream events flowing
threats.threatAction: Attach Bedrock Deny policies at scale across every enrolled account; no volume rate-limit or kill-switch on enforcement
threats.threatImpact: Org-wide Bedrock outage (mass availability DoS) - the catastrophic case of assumption A001.

threats.threatSource: Operational failure at period rollover (IAM throttle, transient error) or a stuck attach
threats.prerequisites: A bbg-deny-* policy attached; detach/delete fails during period-rollover or the attach is stamped-but-not-attached
threats.threatAction: Deny remains attached after the budget period ends (or spend row stamped but principal still blocked/unblocked incorrectly)
threats.threatImpact: A legitimate principal is stuck locked out of Bedrock past the reset (availability). Bounded to affected principals.

Bounded to affected principals.

threats.threatSource: A metered principal that has exceeded its budget and had a bbg-deny-* policy attached
threats.prerequisites: A Bedrock spend path (action/resource/region) not covered by the deny policy statement
threats.threatAction: Keep invoking Bedrock via an un-denied action (e.g. StartAsyncInvoke, batch CreateModelInvocationJob, bidirectional stream) or ARN
threats.threatImpact: Budget-exceeded principal keeps spending (cost overrun) - the enforcement control is bypassed.

threats.threatSource: A metered principal whose deny target expands to a very large resource list (many inference profiles / wildcard)
threats.prerequisites: Enough associated profile ARNs that the policy document approaches the IAM managed-policy 6KB size limit
threats.threatAction: Cause the deny policy resource list to be truncated / the CreatePolicy call to fail, leaving the principal partially or un-denied
threats.threatImpact: Enforcement partially fails; principal keeps spending on the un-covered resources (cost).

threats.prerequisites: A write route that does not call scopeAllows before writing, or a principal ARN whose account cannot be parsed
threats.threatAction: Invoke an admin write (budget create/update/delete/release/toggle) targeting a principal in an account outside the caller's scope
threats.threatImpact: Cross-account privilege escalation: manipulate budgets/enforcement for accounts the admin does not administer.

threats.threatSource: A member of the legacy Cognito Admins group
threats.prerequisites: Legacy Admins group still exists and maps to wildcard scope (migration to BBG-Admin-* incomplete)
threats.threatAction: Sign in and receive bbg:scope=["*"] via the Admins->wildcard fallback, gaining org-wide super-admin
threats.threatImpact: Any member of a broad legacy group gets org-wide admin (elevation) - broader access than intended per-account model.

threats.threatSource: An authenticated admin attempting to widen their own authorization
threats.prerequisites: bbg:scope derivable from a claim the client can influence (client-supplied rather than server-derived)
threats.threatAction: Forge/alter the bbg:scope claim (or a group) in the token to gain wildcard or other-account scope
threats.threatImpact: Spoofed authorization -> cross-account admin. (Mitigated: scope is server-derived by pre-token-gen and JWT-signed.)

(Mitigated: scope is server-derived by pre-token-gen and JWT-signed.)

threats.threatSource: An admin (in scope) supplying a crafted principal/target in a budget or enrollment write
threats.prerequisites: Write path that does not validate the principal/target ARN before it becomes a deny-policy resource
threats.threatAction: Submit a malformed/over-broad target so the generated deny policy resource defaults to '*' or an unintended ARN
threats.threatImpact: Malformed or over-broad Deny (attach to wrong/too-many resources) - tampering with enforcement scope.

threats.threatSource: An admin performing a privileged write that is not covered by the audit emitter
threats.prerequisites: An admin write path that mutates state without calling emitAudit
threats.threatAction: Change budgets/users/pricing/enrollment/enforcement without leaving an audit line
threats.threatImpact: Repudiation: privileged action with no accountability record; weakens incident forensics.

threats.threatSource: A metered principal, or an ingestion-path failure (dropped event, cross-region loss, identity-cache miss)
threats.prerequisites: A gap in invocation-log delivery, cross-region EventBridge forwarding, or the requestId->principal join
threats.threatAction: Cause spend to be under-counted or never joined to a principal so RUNNING_SPEND never crosses the block threshold
threats.threatImpact: Enforcement never triggers; a runaway/over-budget principal keeps spending (cost overrun).

threats.threatSource: An unauthenticated internet actor reading the public SPA
threats.prerequisites: Access to the CloudFront-served public config.json / static assets
threats.threatAction: Read config.json for secrets, or probe for WAF rule gaps against the edge
threats.threatImpact: Info disclosure IF config.json held secrets (it holds only non-secret client config: pool/client id, URLs). Bounded per A002.
